Generated Narrative: CodeSystem v3-MessageCondition

Language: en

Properties

This code system defines the following properties for its concepts

NameCodeURITypeDescription
Statusstatushttp://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#statuscodeDesignation of a concept's state. Normally is not populated unless the state is retired.

Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-MessageCondition defines the following codes in a Is-A hierarchy:

CodeDisplayDefinitionStatus
0 Message acceptedSuccess. Optional, as in version 2.x the AA conveys success. Used for systems that must always return a status code.active
100 Sequence errorThe message elements were not in the proper order, or required elements are missing.active
101 Missing required element.A required message element is missing.active
102 Data type errorAn element is represented by a data type that is not compatible with that which is allowable.active
103 Table value not foundThe value received for a common HL7 or user defined table was not found to match allowable table values.active
200 Unsupported message typeThe message type is not supported.active
201 Unsupported interactionThe identified interaction is not supported.active
202 Unsupported ProcessingIDThe ProcessingID is not supported.active
203 Unsupported VersionIDThe VersionID is not supported.active
204 Unknown key identifierThe identifier for a patient, order, etc. was not found. Occurs for transactions other than additions.active
205 Duplicate key identifierThe identifier for a patient, order, etc. already exists. Occurs in response to addition transactions (e.g. new Admit, new Order, etc.).active
206 Application record lockedThe transaction could not be performed at the application storage level, e.g. database locked.active
207 Application internal errorA catchall for internal errors not explicitly covered by other error codes.active
